intro: Each material its own sound (2026-11-16), after your note on round 11: the thrown thing's own sound is the hit sound, so every material should have one. Three materials still borrowed another's: snow played the soft splat, crystal the glass shatter and bone the crate smash. Each gets its own sound here, three ideas with three takes each (the game picks one at random); "Now" is the borrowed sound it played until today. Two of your round-5 sounds, stone and ice, start late when measured: the loudest crack comes 60 to 165 ms after the sound begins, which is slow for a hit on an enemy. For those, "Yours, started on the crack" is your same three takes with the lead-in cut off, next to two new ideas; the game keeps playing yours as they are until you choose. Wood and soft have one take much quieter than the others; "Yours, one loudness" evens them out. Press Repeat to hear an option several times. The game plays option A of the three new sounds meanwhile (?audition and F7/F8 switch options in the game). Pick one per sound, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.
